final_candidates.decision_summary: W504 at the apex of the G head lies within the m102.4 epitope and is a documented escape position; alanine strongly disrupts the paratope contact. Moderate confidence due to possible cost to ephrin-B2/B3 binding at the overlapping receptor-binding surface.

A conservative aromatic substitution at the same escape hot-spot likely perturbs m102.4 heavy-chain contacts while better preserving hydrophobic receptor-binding character. Lower escape certainty but reduced viability risk.

Q502 (WT Q verified in the NWRNNT motif) sits on the epitope rim adjacent to W504; an arginine adds steric/electrostatic clash for m102.4 with modest expected receptor impact. Uncapped confidence due to unquantified effects.

stop_reason.detail: Further LLM-only self-iteration is unlikely to improve the Top-3 since the pool already covers the known m102.4 epitope apex and no external evidence is available.

history.rationale: W504 lies near the hydrophobic core of the m102.4 epitope; alanine substitution disrupts antibody contact while being distant from the ephrin-binding site on the G surface.

W504 sits at the apex of the G head directly in the m102.4 epitope and is a documented escape position; alanine here strongly disrupts the antibody paratope contact. Some risk to ephrin-B2/B3 binding since W504 also contributes to the receptor-binding surface, hence moderate confidence.

A conservative aromatic substitution at the same escape position may perturb the m102.4 heavy-chain contact while better preserving the hydrophobic character needed for ephrin-B2/B3 binding, reducing viability risk.

Q502 (verified WT Q in ...NWRNNT... region, position 502) lies adjacent to the W504 epitope apex on the receptor-binding rim; a charged substitution can add local steric/electrostatic clash for m102.4 with modest receptor impact.
N506 is within the m102.4-contacting rim; introducing negative charge can weaken antibody binding, though risk to ephrin binding is uncertain so confidence is capped.
Conservative change adjacent to the escape hot-spot likely has small effect on m102.4, kept only as a low-confidence backup for structure-preserving escape tuning.
